model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the training loss over iterations for various models, including a baseline "Vanilla" model and several variants of SepLLM and StrmLLM. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," represents the number of training iterations, ranging from 0 to 140,000 on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," shows the loss value, ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, also on a linear scale. The "Vanilla" model, represented by a purple line, starts with a loss of approximately 3.3 and steadily decreases to about 2.5 by 140,000 iterations. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" model, shown in blue, begins at a loss of 3.3 and declines to around 2.6. The "SepLLM (n=64)" model, in orange, starts at 3.3 and reduces to approximately 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" model, in green, follows a similar trend, starting at 3.3 and decreasing to about 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" model, in red, starts at 3.3 and drops to around 2.5. Finally, the "SepLLM (n=128)" model, in dark blue, begins at 3.3 and decreases to approximately 2.5. All models show a rapid initial decrease in loss, followed by a slower convergence towards a stable value.
